items.title: George Justin Interview, 1958-06-01
items.q: when he organized, he wasn't playing them kind of tunes. Because he had written some tunes I think when he was in New York with Lois Russell's band.

ctx.x: Was Millenburg going when you were a boy?

Millenburg, yes. That's where they used to go out on the beach down, Millenburg, and I think that's where the song more or less was derived from, this Millenburg joy. Yeah. And it was a funny thing. I didn't know, as much as I had played with Paul Barber, and I just found out not too long ago that he had written this number, the Bourbon Street Parade. I didn't know that. You didn't remember that? No, it did not until I went down to Jazz Limited one night. I talked to Freddie Coleman and another buddy of mine was…
When I came back, Sweet Papa. Yeah. A couple of others.
